summary: FD_ED_TC_01_Identification | Full Name + E-Ticket Number | Multiple Tickets | Eligible | APPR EL-01
title: Identification | Full Name + E-Ticket Number | Multiple Tickets | Eligible | APPR EL-01
description:
Validates that the chatbot can successfully identify a customer using their full name and e-ticket number when PNR is not available. Customer has 3 ticket numbers from rebookings � system must handle exchanged tickets gracefully and accept the active one. Tests Auth Flow 2 (e-ticket identification path).

Prerequisites:
PNR: TCED01 exists in Trip Tracer; Customer has 3 e-ticket numbers from rebookings (014-1234567890 exchanged, 014-2345678901 exchanged, 014-3456789012 active); 1 leg AC operated (YUL?YYZ); Delay 4 hrs; Code 42 controllable; APPR applicable; 72 hrs elapsed; No duplicate; Not employee; Not infant
